prompt: In {workspace}\big, find where MARKER_TOKEN_ZULU is defined and tell me the exact value it is set to, then change that value to 'rewritten'.
why: A SOURCE FILE THAT DOES NOT FIT IN ONE READ. `read_file` used to hand the whole file to a 6,000-character clip — about 150 lines — with no argument that could reach line 200, so on any real repository the agent could read the top of a file and nothing else. The marker here sits at roughly line 700 of 900, which is unreachable by that route and trivial by the intended one: search_code says which line, read_file takes a window around it, edit_file changes it. The last two checks are what stop a passing run from having rewritten the file: the line count must still be 900 and the final line must still be there, so replacing a 900-line module with a four-line one that happens to contain the marker fails. NOTE: the runner verifies the MACHINE, never the agent's prose, so 'tell me the value' is not checked directly — reaching line 700 to edit it is the observable proof it got there.
